title: Kissed Crispy Ukrainian Beef Skillet
description: A mustardy and crisp Ukrainian dish featuring dark brown soft sugar and kombu cold extract, cooked to perfection in an iron teppan, this meal prep recipe is anti inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan over medium high heat to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the olive oil to the preheated teppan and swirl it around to coat the surface.
Add the chopped onion to the teppan and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the teppan and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the beef strips to the teppan and cook until they are browned and cooked through.
Add the whole grain mustard, dark brown soft sugar, kombu cold extract, salt, and black pepper to the teppan and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the kissed crispy Ukrainian beef skillet hot and enjoy.
